rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-blue-600
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-cyan-50

typography.install_instructions: Add Google Fonts for Unbounded, JetBrains Mono, and Orbitron.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid - High density, functional beauty, glowing borders.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: p-6 lg:p-8 for main panels, generous spacing to let glowing elements breathe.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align data and text. Center-align main immersive 3D scenes.

surfaces_and_components.panels: Crystal Glassmorphism with 1px inner stroke (border-white/10). High backdrop-blur (backdrop-blur-2xl).
surfaces_and_components.borders: Use 'The Tracing Beam' concept for active agents - animate a glowing border around active panels.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Retro-futuristic tactile buttons. Dark background, neon cyan border, hover state triggers a glow and background fill.
surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat background (bg-slate-900/50), 1px subtle border, hover state adds a cyan shadow-lg and translates Y by -2px.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background and text color, plus add a subtle neon drop-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Implement a slow-moving parallax starfield background behind all glass panels.
motion_and_interactions.synapse_firing: Use Framer Motion to animate glowing paths between neural nodes in the workspace.
motion_and_interactions.loading: ASCII art or rotating concentric circular loader mimicking an Arc Reactor.

images.description: Deep space starfield for parallax background
Abstract holographic neural texture for glowing panels or empty states

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5, color with cyan or slate-400 depending on active state.

advanced_visuals.neural_network: Use React Force Graph 3D, visx, or D3.js. Nodes must be glowing orbs (holographic styling). Links must have particle animations traveling along them (synapse firing).
advanced_visuals.particles: Use TSParticles for ambient floating dust/stars in the background if not using an image.
advanced_visuals.agent_chamber: Visualized as glowing 'server racks' or concentric rings that pulse when an agent is 'thinking'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-screen layout (h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden) to mimic an OS/Dashboard interface.
Implement the Parallax Space Background using TSParticles or CSS fixed background with the provided space starfield image.
The Main Workspace is a center stage containing the neural network.
Surround the workspace with Glassmorphic panels (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10).
Agent Chamber should be a sidebar or floating panel indicating AI states with glowing dots.
Thought Input Panel should be a sleek command-line style input at the bottom center.
Ensure all fonts use Unbounded for headers and JetBrains Mono for data/body.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
